title: ProCut White Lite Sunflower - 2x Mini Plug Plants - White Sunflowers - Unusual
description:
Sunflower ‘ProCut White Lite’ – Premium Cut Flower Variety



ProCut White Lite is an elegant and reliable sunflower variety, producing pale creamy-white to soft yellow petals surrounding a light golden-green central disc. This pollen-free variety is specially bred for cutting, making it ideal for floral arrangements, bouquets, and wedding displays.



Plants produce single, strong stems with large blooms measuring approximately 4–6 inches across. Reaching heights of 120–180 cm (5–6 ft), these sunflowers are well-suited for borders, cutting gardens, or growing in groups for visual impact. They are also suitable for planting near trees or water features and can tolerate partial shade.



Sow seeds from April to May for flowering between July and September. This half-hardy annual is easy to grow and a great choice for gardeners of all levels, including children.



Key Features:



Variety: ProCut White Lite


Type: Half-hardy annual


Height: 120–180 cm (5–6 ft)


Flower size: 4–6 inches


Colour: Creamy white to pale yellow petals with golden-green centre


Pollen-free – ideal for cut flowers


Single-stemmed, strong and reliable growth


Suitable for beds, borders, and cutting gardens


Sow: April–May


Flowers: July–September



A popular and dependable sunflower, perfect for both garden display and professional-quality floral arrangements.
